candidate_workaround: Classify a runner witness as passing when it either has a top-level passed or valid boolean, or is a nonempty mapping whose every result object has passed true.
failure_signature: The first aggregate runner ledger treated the runtime and core all-runner result maps as failures because it required a top-level passed or valid field.
recurrence_guard: Inspect witness shape before projecting pass state and require every child result to pass for mapped all-runner witnesses.
rollback: Keep the aggregate runner receipt invalid and assign zero aggregate credit if any child result is missing or fails.
scope_boundary: Owner-local runner witness aggregation only; no scientific, authority, production, or independent-reproduction claim.
title: Shape-aware aggregate runner witness projection
trigger_preconditions: a runner witness may be a single result or a named result map
each mapped result declares a passed boolean
